::: {#sol-random-draws}

-   **The starting weights.**
    `torch.manual_seed(seed)` seeds PyTorch's global random number generator,
    and each `nn.Linear` draws its starting weights and biases from it.
-   **The order of the [minibatches](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-minibatch).**
    `shuffler`, a generator of its own seeded with `seed`,
    draws a new order of the training images in each [epoch](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch).
-   **The split.**
    `order`, drawn once outside the function from a generator seeded with 481,
    decides which images are for training and which for validation.
    Every run shares it,
    so the runs differ in their seeds and settings but not in their data.

A network with [dropout](regularization.qmd#def-dropout) would draw one more random mask at each step,
from the global generator.

:::
